scope: Targeted primary-source bibliography for model/construct positioning; not an exhaustive priority search. Publisher or author article pages were inspected. No source was accepted from an aggregator alone.

references.title: No Unbiased Estimator of the Variance of K-Fold Cross-Validation
references.verification: Official JMLR publisher page metadata and abstract inspected on 2026-09-05 during final manuscript review. The inspected page supplies no DOI; no DOI invented.
references.use: Primary theoretical and numerical analysis of cross-validation covariance and lack of a universal unbiased variance estimator.
references.boundary: Supports the general concern about overlap-induced error dependence; does not quantify the direction or size of interval miscoverage for this EDL dataset.

references.title: A mechanism for memory storage insensitive to molecular turnover: a bistable autophosphorylating kinase
references.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
references.verification: Primary article deposited in PMC; metadata and abstract. Publisher URL returned HTTP 403, not treated as content access.
references.use: Essential antecedent: a biochemical model explicitly addresses memory surviving molecular replacement. Present work does not originate that possibility.
references.boundary: A theoretical mechanism, not confirmation that this simulated field uses kinase bistability.

references.authors: Timothy S. Gardner; Charles R. Cantor; James J. Collins
references.title: Construction of a genetic toggle switch in Escherichia coli
references.verification: Publisher metadata, abstract and figure descriptions; accessible through publisher .pdf route redirect. Full subscription text not claimed read.
references.use: Engineered mutual inhibition can implement bistable memory; provides a contrast to an added leaky memory field.
references.boundary: Does not validate the EDL memory field or demonstrate EDL individuality.

references.authors: Wen Xiong; James E. Ferrell Jr
references.title: A positive-feedback-based bistable memory module that governs a cell fate decision
references.verification: Publisher metadata and abstract inspected. Linked correction independently opened.
references.use: Positive-feedback intervention distinguishes sustained from transient biochemical response in its experimental system.
references.boundary: A biological comparison; no evidence that EDL has analogous active maintenance.
references.correction_note: 2007 correction changes Box 1 equation and interpretation of plotted stable steady states. Do not reproduce the uncorrected equation.

references.authors: David Krakauer; Nils Bertschinger; Eckehard Olbrich; Jessica C. Flack; Nihat Ay
references.title: The information theory of individuality
references.verification: Publisher full text including system-environment decomposition and distinct individuality quantities inspected.
references.use: Essential adjacent framework: system/environment partition and shared, unique and synergistic information matter for individuation.
references.boundary: EDL ridge prediction differences are not these information-theoretic quantities or a universal ownership definition.

references.title: Semantic information, autonomous agency and non-equilibrium statistical physics
references.verification: Author-hosted published PDF first-page metadata and conceptual definition; author arXiv abstract; publisher indexed article text. Direct publisher re-open failed.
references.use: Distinguishes mere correlation from information causally necessary to a specified viability criterion.
references.boundary: EDL uptake intervention does not evaluate this framework's existence/viability criterion or establish agency.

references.authors: David Zwicker; Rabea Seyboldt; Christoph A. Weber; Anthony A. Hyman; Frank Juelicher
references.title: Growth and division of active droplets provides a model for protocells
references.verification: Publisher abstract and bibliographic fields, via .pdf redirect; online publication 2016-12-12, volume year 2017.
references.use: Chemically driven droplet growth and shape instability are established model routes to division.
references.boundary: EDL is not a quantitative model or empirical validation of these active droplets; separation alone is not heredity.

references.authors: Carsten Donau; Fabian Spaeth; Marilyne Sosson; Brigitte A. K. Kriebisch; Fabian Schnitter; Marta Tena-Solsona; Hyun-Seo Kang; Elia Salibi; Michael Sattler; Hannes Mutschler; Job Boekhoven
references.title: Active coacervate droplets as a model for membraneless organelles and protocells
references.verification: Publisher PDF first page and introduction inspected, including fuel-driven cycle, component exchange and fragmentation.
references.use: Physical precedent for fuel-regulated compartments, rapid component exchange and retained molecular function.
references.boundary: No claim that such droplets meet EDL ownership criteria or that EDL proves their memory.

references.authors: Erwan Plantec; Gautier Hamon; Mayalen Etcheverry; Bert Wang-Chak Chan; Pierre-Yves Oudeyer; Clement Moulin-Frier
references.title: Flow-Lenia: Emergent Evolutionary Dynamics in Mass Conservative Continuous Cellular Automata
references.verification: Author arXiv abstract, full author list, accepted-publication notice and exact journal reference/DOI inspected. Publisher DOI fetch failed.
references.use: Recent computational precedent for mass-conservative localized patterns, localized parameters and evolutionary-activity analysis.
references.boundary: Not EDL's architecture and not a test of EDL's memory-ownership criterion. Do not conflate 2023 conference version with 2025 journal article.

references.title: Rethinking self-replication: detecting distributed selfhood in the outlier cellular automaton
references.verification: Publisher full text read for entity/cluster/formation definitions, causal ancestry and limitations; publication 2026-02-16.
references.use: Current evidence that causal organization and replication can involve multiple spatially disjoint clusters.
references.boundary: Their deterministic causal-ancestry rule is not EDL's centroid tracker or its paired intervention. No direct replication claimed.

references.title: Memory as activity: pattern formation in a conserved scalar field
references.verification: Author arXiv metadata and abstract; v1 2025-10-20, v2 2026-03-24. No journal reference present on inspected record.
references.use: Recent adjacent work on prescribed temporal memory kernels and pattern formation in conserved active fields.
references.boundary: Not peer-reviewed status asserted; not turnover/ownership evidence. Optional awareness item, unnecessary to core manuscript.

references.authors: Simon M. S. Lo; Ralf A. Wilke; Takeshi Emura
references.title: A semiparametric model for the cause-specific hazard under risk proportionality
references.verification: Publisher article and authors' institutional published PDF first page/introduction inspected.
references.use: Directly distinguishes observable cause-specific/subdistribution hazards from unidentified latent marginal hazards without dependence restrictions.
references.boundary: Supports correction of CCRA rationale only. No claim that EDL data satisfy this paper's parametric model.

excluded_from_primary_core.title: Biomolecular condensates as cellular memory modules: Thermodynamic principles and plant stress adaptation
excluded_from_primary_core.reason: Inspected article identifies itself as a review/proposed framework; cannot be used as primary experimental proof of condensate memory or heredity. Optional background only.
